requests.title: nextId > is one past the max id
requests.reason: Its fixture objects used the `done` field, which no longer exists on Todo after the required rename and would fail type-checking. I changed only `done` to `completed` in those objects, as the instruction asks. The assertion (expects 8) is unchanged.

requests.title: format > formats open and done todos
requests.reason: The fixtures used `done: true/false`, but Todo now has `completed` instead of `done`. With the old fixtures, formatTodo reads `completed` (undefined) and renders the done todo as "[ ] eggs", so the test fails. It also stops type-checking. I only renamed `done` to `completed` in the fixtures. The expected output strings are the same.

requests.title: storage > round-trips todos
requests.reason: The fixture used `done: false`, which no longer exists on Todo. The instruction requires save/load to use `completed`, so a todo with `done` no longer round-trips unchanged. Changed the fixture to `completed: false`; what the test checks is the same.

requests.title: commands > adds and completes
requests.reason: This test reads `t.done`, which no longer exists on Todo now that it has been renamed to `completed`. It would fail to type-check and would get undefined at runtime. I changed it to read `t.completed`. The expected values ([true, false]) and what the test checks are the same.
